name: edit_project_env
description:
Edit an existing environment variable of a project, identified by project ID or name and variable ID. Provided fields (key, value, type, target environments, git branch, custom environment IDs, comment) are updated.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} env update {name} {environment} --project {projectIdOrName}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

comment.description: A comment to add context on what this env var is for

customEnvironmentIds.description: The custom environments that the environment variable should be synced to

anyOf.description: If defined, the git branch of the environment variable (must have target=preview)

key.description: The name of the environment variable

target.description: The target environment of the environment variable

value.description: The value of the environment variable

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
